note_on_prior_knowledge: The locked headline results of FS-1 v1.3.2, R2A (+corrigendum) and the product-tail grid are already published and are cited as-is. This record freezes the method for the NEW per-cell Pareto action-labelling analysis performed by FS-FUSION-CAL-1, which has not been computed at the time this record is written.

domain_separation.rule: MANDATORY. In-process (FS1, R2A) and faithful netns (PRODUCT) rows are NEVER pooled into a single population.
permitted: external validation of a region label
forbidden: pooling in-process and netns latency into one distribution
presenting an in-process FEC effect as a faithful product effect
counting the product ARQ-tail result as product FEC validation

endpoint_hierarchy_lexicographic.rule: any action with a safety/invariant failure in a cell is ELIMINATED from that cell before any other comparison
higher is better; censoring is the complement
lower is better; compared only when completion is not distinguishable
reported ALWAYS with its completion population; never a standalone headline

deadline_endpoint.rule: deadline_hit is reported separately and never substituted for horizon completion. No product SLO exists; the benchmark deadline is not an SLO.

no_scalar_utility.rule: No arbitrary scalar utility weighting of completion vs cost is invented. Pareto / non-dominance is used first. If a numeric non-inferiority margin would be required and is not defined by an existing product requirement, the cell is left as NON_DOMINATED_TRADEOFF or INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE rather than silently inventing a threshold.

statistics.paired_binary_effect: McNemar exact (binomial on discordant pairs, two-sided), alpha=0.05; pairing unit = pairing_group_id (cell + repetition/seed lineage)
statistics.cost_delta: paired/grouped bootstrap, 10000 resamples, resampling at the pairing-group level (never row-level), 95% percentile interval, fixed RNG seed 20260804
statistics.censored_time: Kaplan-Meier + RMST restricted to the cell observation horizon
statistics.conditional_latency: median over completed rows, always reported with n_complete
statistics.multiple_comparisons: the number of cells and pairwise contrasts is reported explicitly; per-cell labels are SCREENING-grade and are not presented as confirmatory family-wise-controlled inference
statistics.small_n_caveats: FS-1 n=5 per cell/arm is exploratory only; R2A n=100 and PRODUCT n=30 are evaluated separately and never merged

decision_procedure_ordered: 1. Drop any action with a safety/invariant failure in the cell (SAFETY_REJECTED if all drop).
2. Pairwise within the SAME domain only. Completion: McNemar exact on paired discordance. If p<0.05 and direction consistent, the winner is completion-superior.
3. If completion is NOT distinguishable (p>=0.05), compare realized total wire via grouped bootstrap; a strictly lower cost whose 95% CI excludes 0 is cost-superior.

5. If exactly one action is superior at the highest discriminating rank and not worse at a higher rank, label by its family: ARQ_* -> ARQ_DOMINANT, FEC_* -> FEC_DOMINANT, simultaneous ARQ+FEC -> FUSION_DOMINANT.
6. If two actions trade off across ranks (one completes more, the other costs less) -> NON_DOMINATED_TRADEOFF.
7. If CIs are too wide / n too small to discriminate -> INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE. Never force a winner.

8. If the region cannot be identified from runtime-observable features -> UNSUPPORTED_RUNTIME_FEATURES (overrides the outcome label for POLICY purposes; the outcome label is still recorded for science).
per_cell_action_labels.fusion_coverage_note: No authoritative arm combines tail-capable ARQ with proactive FEC simultaneously. FUSION_DOMINANT therefore CANNOT be established from existing data and any fusion region is INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE until supplementary training covers it.

leakage_firewall.rule: These are configuration/outcome/label fields. They may be used for OFFLINE analysis and region definition only. A runtime policy may consume ONLY prefix-causal features that the sender can compute at decision time.
leakage_firewall.critical_finding: All 10930 authoritative rows have runtime_features_present=0 (no runtime fusion-input telemetry was recorded). Therefore NO runtime feature->action map can be fitted from the authoritative data alone; authoritative data grounds CELL->ACTION->OUTCOME only. The runtime-feature bridge must come from supplementary training runs that record telemetry, or the region is UNSUPPORTED.

grouping_and_splits.rule: the same cell/seed lineage may never appear on both sides of a train/validation split; validation outcomes are not opened during tuning
grouping_and_splits.true_holdout: a NEW disjoint seed domain executed after the pre-holdout freeze

amendment_v1_1.reason: METHOD-CORRECTNESS FIX, not an outcome-driven threshold. The first execution of the v1 procedure revealed two statistical/reporting defects that would have produced misleading labels. Both are corrected here and the analysis was re-run in full. The uncorrected first-pass output is preserved as decision-regions.v1-uncorrected.csv.

defect_1_underpowered_cost_fallthrough.observed: With FS-1 n=5 per cell/arm the McNemar exact test has almost no power: 61 of 72 FS-1 contrasts fell through to the wire-cost rank. Where every arm completed 5/5 this is a legitimate Pareto conclusion (equal completion, lower cost dominates), but where completion differs numerically yet is statistically undetectable, letting cost decide silently would assert a preference the data cannot support.
defect_1_underpowered_cost_fallthrough.fix: Split the non-significant completion outcome into two cases: (a) COMPLETION-IDENTICAL on every paired group (zero discordance, a_only==b_only==0) -> proceed to cost as a valid Pareto comparison; (b) DISCORDANCE PRESENT but p>=alpha -> mark completion_underpowered=true; a cost winner is only accepted if it does NOT contradict the numeric completion direction, otherwise the contrast is NON_DOMINATED_TRADEOFF (never force a winner).
defect_1_underpowered_cost_fallthrough.principle: This tightens, never loosens, the conditions under which a winner is declared.

defect_2_family_label_collapse.observed: In PRODUCT_NETNS both arms (ARQ_FROZEN=tail probe OFF, ARQ_TAIL=tail probe ON) belong to the ARQ family, so the family-level label ARQ_DOMINANT is uninformative and hides which action is preferred.
defect_2_family_label_collapse.fix: Emit preferred_action as a first-class column alongside the family label, and report the per-domain preferred-action distribution.

amendment_v1_1.integrity_note: No endpoint, alpha, bootstrap seed, endpoint ordering, or domain-separation rule was changed. No numeric non-inferiority margin was invented.
